claim_scope: VocalSet excerpt identity retrieval with a straight-singing query and a same-singer vibrato positive; two frozen pretrained families
interpretation_limit: The SSL preprocessing correction was found in a post-hoc audit. The two primary conditions still meet the numerical pilot threshold, but post-hoc controls and crop sensitivity prevent a technique-specific causal conclusion. This is not a published-score reproduction or a reason to develop the proposed model from this gate alone.
